```{=html}
<script>
    function initializeDailyPhoto() {
        fetch('/photography/picked-photo/photos.json')
        .then(response => response.json())
        .then(data => {
            const photos = data.photos;
            const today = new Date();
            const seed = today.getFullYear() * 1000 + (today.getMonth()) * 100 + today.getDate();
            
            // Simple pseudo-random number generator
            function seededRandom(seed) {
                let x = Math.sin(seed) * 10000;
                return x - Math.floor(x);
            }

            const randomIndex = Math.floor(seededRandom(seed) * photos.length);
            const photo = photos[randomIndex];
            
            const photoElement = document.getElementById('daily-photo');
            photoElement.innerHTML = `
            <div class="name-title" style="font-size: 2rem">Today's Pick</div>
            <br>
            <div class="image-container">
                <div class="pick-image">
                <a href="https://zzzhehao.github.io/photography/gallery/gallery.html#${photo.name}">
                    <img src="${photo.url}" alt="${photo.name}">
                </a>
                </div>
            </div>
            `;
        });
    }

    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', initializeDailyPhoto);
</script>
```

[About {{< iconify cib:about-me >}}]{style="font-size: 2.5rem;"}

Hi! 👋 I am Zhehao. I was born and raised in Japan, lived both in Mainland China and Taiwan for some time, and I am currently studying in Hamburg. So I speak 中文, 日本語, Deutsch, English, y un poquito Español 😉 feel free to write me in any of these!

I am a M.Sc. Biology Student at University of Hamburg. I have received my B.Sc. degree with focus on molecular ecology and am now entering deep sea research with special focus on isopods. I love doing lab works but I love field works a bit more; I have interest in new technologies but I am more interested in biological process happening out there in the wild. I am trying my best to find a balance among all these.

My strengths are molecular barcoding, evolutionary, community ecology, and biogeography analysis. I started developing my taxonomic expertise around asellote isopods and the swimming Munnopsids are my favourite, despite their taxonomy and biogeography being quite difficult to decipher.

Beside these, I'm also a heavy R coder! I write a lot of codes to automate my daily works to prevent data lost and avoidable mistakes (typos are horrible when happening to identifiers! And yes it happens a LOT). And I love making pretty plots, maps, and analysis that makes boring data understandable and communicable.

## {{< iconify ph:film-reel >}} Hobbies

I take a lot of photos, simply to treasure the moments that I enjoyed and loved. I don't limit myself in certain technics or topics - I shoot both analog and digital, still and motion picture, I once tried cyanotype too, and would love to start again. I shoot wonderful nature, starlight, but also urban landscapes, people, but mostly small things in life that have made my day a bit different.

I use photography as a way to express myself. People say the world is as one sees it. I haven't experienced excessive grief, but I've certainly seen enough. So when I create something back for the world, I want them to be something less hurting.

You can see all my albums in my [gallery](/photography/gallery/gallery.qmd) and some picked [motion pictures](/photography/gallery/motion-pictures.qmd).
